headline: 🔭 Game Day Spotlight — Mariners vs Blue Jays
subhead: 8 Quintonia managers are at the Mariners game this afternoon! Here's who to watch in the game that can actually swing a matchup (and who can't). Status as of first pitch; it's the final day of the week, so lots of opportunity for WP shifts throughout the day.

watch.watch: R (the Dawgs are actually trailing here) and OPS are the live cats now — HR has locked up. The Giraffes have nobody in this game, so every Dawgs run is uncontested leverage.
Same live cats (R / OPS) for the Dawgs — a multi-hit day chips at the Runs category they trail and pads OPS.
Jo Mamas' whole ERA/WHIP longshot rides on him — he's ~70% of their remaining innings. With those cats now ~95% the other way, a gem is their only realistic path to stealing a pitching category.
The Melonheads' ERA/WHIP defender. A gem slams the door on those cats; a blow-up is exactly the crack Jo Mamas need.
Feeds the contested HR / R / OPS for underdog Jo Mamas — a homer helps all three.
SVHD is contested (tie-heavy). A save or hold tonight banks the one contested pitching-side category for the Melonheads.

minor.label: Out tonight
minor.body: Julio Rodríguez (7-day DL), George Springer (paternity), Alejandro Kirk (benched).

minor.label: Not pitching today, so no arm impact
minor.body: Woo, Gilbert, Kirby, Miller (SEA); Cease, Gausman, Bieber (TOR).

minor.label: In a decided matchup — can go off, won't move it
minor.body: Cal Raleigh & Daulton Varsho (Sox Teacher, ~99%); Arozarena, Colt Emerson, José Ferrer (Bear Nation, ~1%); Bazardo & Ernie Clement (Bums, ~2%); Tyler Rogers (Shih Tzus, ~95%).

minor.label: Live matchup but wrong category
minor.body: Andrés Muñoz (Dawgs) and Louis Varland (WAR) — their SVHD isn't a contested cat in those matchups, so a save barely registers.

notes.title: The fun wrinkle
notes.body: Jo Mamas roster BOTH Hancock (a Mariner) and Okamoto (a Blue Jay) — on opposite sides of tonight's real game. If Hancock deals, he shuts down his own manager's bat.

notes.title: Why m81 is the one to watch
notes.body: Jo Mamas have slipped to the underdog side as the Melonheads' pitching leads hardened (ERA/WHIP now ~95%+ the other way). Their comeback path runs through those rate stats, which ride entirely on the Hancock and Yesavage starts — so this is still the matchup today's game swings most.
